title: Zscaler Shares Fall 3.81% as Price Sits Below Key Averages
text:
Zscaler Shares Fall 3.81% as Price Sits Below Key Averages | TokenPost 
 Advertisement Friday, November 20, 2026 Sections Sign in News Markets Feed Data Research Home Investing 1 min read Add as a preferred source on Google Zscaler Shares Fall 3.81% as Price Sits Below Key Averages
 Shares were listed at $200.43 in a Nov. 20 snapshot, below the 20-day and 50-day averages. Technical analysis put the pivot at $205.77.
 By Enna Lee Published Nov 20, 2026, 6:52 AM EST Save Share A red glass line descends beside a geometric paper certificate / TokenPost.ai Zscaler (ZS) was listed at $200.43 after a 3.81% decline over 24 hours in a Nov. 20 snapshot, putting the stock below its 20-day and 50-day moving averages.
 The snapshot was published at 6:46 a.m. ET (11:46 UTC). Shares traded between $198.54 and $218.35 during the period and remained above the seven-day simple moving average of $196.63. The 20-day average was $203.08, while the 50-day average was $217.33.
 The technical analysis placed the relevant pivot at $205.77, with immediate resistance at $213.01 and stronger resistance at $225.58. It identified support at $193.20 and stronger support at $185.96. The $203.08 level also marked the middle Bollinger band.
 Momentum indicators were mixed. The relative strength index was 44.32, while the moving average convergence-divergence reading was negative 6.5874 with a flat histogram. Volume during the decline was 0.43 times the five-day average.
 Zscaler raised its fiscal 2027 growth outlook from 16% to 17% to 16.6% to 17.4%. Truist reiterated a Buy rating and a $250 price target on Nov. 16.
